name: interactioncombinators
description: Lafont's interaction combinators on a Void Maiz canvas: every gesture and every rewrite is a dispatched, logged, undoable Void Core command, and two people can reduce one net at once.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, gestures, inspector, the reduce executor, the collaboration layer, the phone layout kit and the update client. Void Maiz in turn locates Void Core (../VoidCore) and Void Allomone (../VoidAllomone).

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: sync, and since 0.6.0 the network itself: Void Palabra's voidpalabra_reticulum (a vendored microReticulum) carries every link. Present: the desktop build gains Host/Join and the two-window duo bench. Absent: the app builds solo.

platforms_note: A SHIPPING RECORD, as Void Maiz and Void Hormiga use the field: both were built and handed to a person (0.2.0, 2026-09-21; the author ran the APK on a phone). The Windows build is a portable .zip and the Android build an .apk, not the setup.exe / .tar.gz that `mago feed` names today, so tools/package_release.ps1 fills in the artifact names and hashes after Mago writes the document (asked of Void Mago 2026-09-21).

release.summary: sharing a net is now encrypted (Reticulum), a host knows a device it let in before, and the phone types with its own keyboard
adds: Sharing a net is encrypted end to end: the devices talk over Reticulum, through Void Maiz's RnsSession
A host remembers who it let in by the device's proven identity, so a phone that comes back is let in without asking again, and a stranger cannot claim to be it
The phone types with Android's own keyboard (accents, suggestions, autocorrect), instead of a drawn one

behavior_changes.what: 0.6.0 cannot share a net with 0.5.x or older: the network changed underneath (Reticulum instead of plain TCP). Update every device before sharing
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone sharing a net between devices

behavior_changes.what: Join by code is gone: a Reticulum device is not an address. Nets on the same Wi-Fi appear in the list as before
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone who joined by typing a code

behavior_changes.what: The join request shows a short device fingerprint instead of an IP address
